I co-founded NyanTrace.ai and led product from January to June 2026. I ran five discovery interviews and an enterprise buyer call, wrote the MVP PRD, and shaped it into a governance layer for agents in production: audit trails, policy enforcement, human approvals and kill switches.

qa.q: How did you get into product?

Nexus is an internal AI knowledge platform I led at Method, a Hitachi company. It searches Drive, Slack, Miro and Figma with permission-aware access. It took discovery from 5-6 hours to under 3 minutes for 300+ employees, from research to MVP in 8 weeks.

qa.q: How do you approach AI products?
qa.a: No fabrication, only reframing. At Inflection I narrowed the scope of a generative AI feature when hallucinations made it unsafe to ship broadly. At NyanTrace I build the guardrails: approvals, scoped permissions, kill switches and audit trails.
